# signoz_dashboard (Resource)

Manages a SigNoz dashboard (`/api/v1/dashboards`). `data` is the full dashboard JSON (layout, widgets, `title`, `version`, etc.). See `docs/DASHBOARD_API.md` in this provider repository.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data` (String) Dashboard JSON document. Typically includes `title`, `description`, `tags`, `layout`, `widgets`, and `version` (often `v5` for current SigNoz layouts).

### Optional

- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the dashboard is locked in the UI. Default: `false`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `source` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `updated_by` (String)
